# Sam Foreman

> Sam Foreman is a Computational Scientist in the AI / ML group at the Argonne
> Leadership Computing Facility (ALCF), where he works on the large-scale
> distributed training of AI models for scientific applications. He is co-lead of
> the Models / Pre-Training group for the AuroraGPT project. This site collects
> his posts, talks, and projects on high-performance computing, machine learning,
> and scientific computing.

## Main

- [Home](https://samf.sh/): Landing page with a terminal-style overview of recent work, posts, and talks.
- [About](https://samf.sh/about/): Background, research interests, and contact links.
- [More](https://samf.sh/about/more/): Extended bio, publications, and professional history.
- [Now](https://samf.sh/now/): What Sam is currently focused on.

## Writing

- [Posts](https://samf.sh/posts/): Technical articles on distributed training, HPC, and machine learning for science.
- [Talks](https://samf.sh/talks/): Slide decks and presentations, including the AuroraGPT pre-training series.
- [Projects](https://samf.sh/projects/): Selected research and software projects.
- [Ideas](https://samf.sh/ideas/): Notes and works in progress.

## Feeds

- [RSS feed](https://samf.sh/rss.xml): Subscribe to new posts and talks.
- [Sitemap](https://samf.sh/sitemap-index.xml): Full index of all pages.
